## South Korea's KOSPI Swings from Bear to Bull Market in Just Over a Month on AI Chip Trade

A bear-to-bull KOSPI swing in just over a month driven by AI memory names reflects the scale and speed of the HBM/memory demand repricing; the velocity of the move warrants monitoring for mean-reversion risk in Samsung and SK Hynix, particularly as mainstream coverage may signal peak retail enthusiasm.

- The KOSPI has transitioned from bear-market territory to a bull-market designation in just over a month.
- The AI trade — led by chip demand — is cited as the primary driver of the reversal.
- Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) are identified as the leading contributors.
- CNBC coverage signals the AI chip re-rating narrative has reached mainstream financial media.
